body:
168.  ...  one has to balance the struggle and death 
against the loss of freedom and dignity.  To many 
of us, freedom and dignity are more important than
a long life or avoidance of pain.  Besides, we all 
have to die some time, and it may be better to die fighting for survival, or
for a cause, then to live 
a long but empty and purposeless life.

headers.Subject: Kaczynski views re suicide faced with life imprisonment
